name: Ghost in the Jail: Fantasma en la Cárcel de Devoto
source:
GITJ is a Visual Novel game based on a true story.

Tells the story of a prison guard who, on a normal day at work, begins to hear strange noises and see things that shouldn't be there. Like, for example, the ghost of the eleventh.

[From [url=https://rrankonishgames.itch.io/gitj]Itch.io[/url]]
